arXiv:2605.12421v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 5 月 12 日arXiv:2605.12421v1 [cs.AI] 12 May 2026

形式化，而非优化：Formalize, Don’t Optimize: The启发式陷阱Heuristic Trap在 LLM 生成的组合求解器中in LLM-Generated Combinatorial Solvers

Haoyu Wang1  Yuliang Song2  Tao Li3  Zhiwei Deng3
Yaqing Wang3  Deepak Ramachandran3  Eldan Cohen2  Dan Roth1,4
1University of Pennsylvania  2University of Toronto  3Google DeepMind  4Oracle AI
{why16gzl, danroth}@seas.upenn.edu  {yl.song, eldan.cohen}@utoronto.ca
{tlinlp, zhiweideng, yaqingwang, ramachandrand}@google.com
摘要Abstract

大型语言模型（LLM）很难通过直接推理来解决复杂的组合问题，因此最近的神经符号系统越来越多地使用它们来合成可执行的求解器。一个中心设计问题是法学硕士应该如何表示求解器，以及它是否也应该尝试优化搜索。我们推出 CP-SynC-XL，这是Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to solve complex combinatorial problems through direct reasoning, so recent neuro-symbolic systems increasingly use them to synthesize executable solvers. A central design question is how the LLM should represent the solver, and whether it should also attempt to optimize search. We introduce CP-SynC-XL, a benchmark of100100组合问题（4,577 个实例），并评估三种求解器构造范例：本机算法搜索（combinatorial problems (4,577 instances), and evaluate three solver-construction paradigms: native algorithmic search (蟒蛇Python），通过 Python 求解器 API 进行约束建模（), constraint modeling through a Python solver API (Python + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools）和声明性约束建模（), and declarative constraint modeling (MiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools）。 我们找到一个一致的). We find a consistent代表性分歧representational divergence: Python + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools在法学硕士中获得最高的正确性，同时attains the highest correctness across LLMs, whileMiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools尽管使用相同的 OR-Tools 后端，但绝对覆盖率较低。本地人has lower absolute coverage despite using the same OR-Tools back-end. Native蟒蛇Python最有可能返回验证失败的模式有效解决方案，而求解器支持的路径则保留更高的条件保真度。在启发式轴上，提示搜索优化仅产生较小的中值加速（is the most likely to return a schema-valid solution that fails verification, whereas solver-backed paths preserve higher conditional fidelity. On the heuristic axis, prompting for search optimization yields only small median speed-ups (1.031.03–1.12×1.12\times）和强烈的双峰效应：许多实例速度减慢，并且在问题的长尾问题上正确性急剧下降。 配对的代码级审计将这些回归追溯到重复出现的情况) and a strongly bimodal effect: many instances slow down, and correctness drops sharply on a long tail of problems. A paired code-level audit traces these regressions to a recurring启发式陷阱heuristic trap。在以效率为导向的提示下，法学硕士可能会用局部近似代替完整的搜索（. Under an efficiency-oriented prompt, the LLM may replace complete search with local approximations (蟒蛇Python），注入未经验证的边界（), inject unverified bounds (Python + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools），或者添加冗余的声明机制来压倒或过度约束模型（), or add redundant declarative machinery that overwhelms or over-constrains the model (MiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools）。 这些发现支持 LLM 生成的组合求解器的保守设计原则：主要使用 LLM 来形式化经过验证的求解器的变量、约束和目标，并在使用前单独检查任何 LLM 编写的搜索优化。). These findings support a conservative design principle for LLM-generated combinatorial solvers: use the LLM primarily to formalize variables, constraints, and objectives for verified solvers, and separately check any LLM-authored search optimization before use.

1 简介Introduction

大型语言模型 (LLM) 在数学推理方面表现出了强大的性能Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on mathematical reasoning(Mirzadeh et al., 2024; Jaech et al., 2024; Varambally et al., 2025)和通用代码合成and general-purpose code synthesis(Liu et al., 2024a; Comanici et al., 2025)，但复杂的组合优化仍然是一个困难的设置。虽然法学硕士可以解决基本的逻辑难题, yet complex combinatorial optimization remains a difficult setting. While LLMs can navigate basic logical puzzles(Shojaee et al., 2025)，它们的推理在现实世界组合问题的大搜索空间和隐含域约束特征上退化。随着问题复杂性的增加，自回归生成过程成为“推理瓶颈”, their reasoning degrades on the large search spaces and implicit domain constraints characteristic of real-world combinatorial problems. As problem complexity scales, the autoregressive generation process becomes a “reasoning bottleneck”(Fan et al., 2024; Jiang et al., 2026)：如果没有可靠的内部状态跟踪来进行前向检查和回溯，模型就会做出早期的次优决策，并且可能会失去跨长期约束的全局一致性。: without reliable internal state tracking for forward-checking and backtracking, models commit to early sub-optimal decisions and may lose global consistency across long-horizon constraints.

为了缓解这一限制，最近的工作通过外部控制结构（例如 A* 搜索）增强了法学硕士To mitigate this limitation, recent work augments LLMs with external control structures such as A* search(Zhuang et al., 2023)，蒙特卡罗树搜索（MCTS）, Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)(Liu et al., 2025)，或代理工作记忆, or agentic working memory(Xu et al., 2025)。这些交互式方法显式地维护状态并将中间决策暴露给回溯或搜索。然而，在 NP 难领域中使用 LLM 作为交互式搜索代理会导致较高的推理延迟和令牌成本. These interactive approaches explicitly maintain states and expose intermediate decisions to backtracking or search. However, using an LLM as an interactive search agent in NP-hard domains incurs high inference latency and token cost(Yang et al., 2024; Jiang et al., 2026);此外，外部记忆本身并不能消除可以引导过程走向局部最优的启发式盲点; moreover, external memory does not by itself remove heuristic blind spots that can steer the process toward local optima(Wang et al., 2025)。 这些限制促使将计算负担从直接文本推理中转移出来。一项有前途的策略利用法学硕士驱动的程序综合. These limitations motivate shifting the computational burden away from direct textual reasoning. One promising strategy leverages LLM-driven program synthesis(Duchnowski et al., 2025; Michailidis et al., 2025)：LLM 编写一个与实例无关的可执行工件，将问题需求形式化，而实际的组合搜索要么在该工件内部运行，要么委托给经过验证的后端。: the LLM writes an instance-agnostic executable artefact that formalizes the problem requirements, while the actual combinatorial search either runs inside that artefact or is delegated to a verified backend.

这个综合设置贯穿两个开放性问题：Two open questions run through this synthesis setting:如何howLLM 应该代表求解者吗？should the LLM represent the solver, and是否whether法学硕士应该通过生成启发式方法积极优化搜索。 在代表性方面，我们发现the LLM should actively optimize search by generating heuristics. On representation, we find a代表性分歧representational divergence：法学硕士使用 Python 求解器 API 比使用声明性建模语言更成功，即使两者都使用相同的 OR-Tools 后端。在搜索优化方面，我们使用: LLMs are more successful with a Python solver API than with a declarative modeling language, even when both use the same OR-Tools back-end. On search optimization, we use启发式陷阱heuristic trap表示重复出现的模式，其中以效率为导向的提示会导致未经验证的边界、局部近似或过于复杂的约束，这些约束有时以速度为目标，但会降低正确性或保真度。to denote the recurring pattern in which an efficiency-oriented prompt induces unverified bounds, local approximations, or overcomplicated constraints that sometimes target speed but reduce correctness or fidelity.

我们通过评估三个前沿法学硕士来研究这些问题（We study these questions by evaluating three frontier LLMs (GPT-5.3-法典GPT-5.3-Codex, 双子座3.1专业版Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek-V3.2）在 CP-SynC-XL 上，CP-SynC 的扩展) on CP-SynC-XL, an extension of CP-SynC(Song and Cohen, 2026), 与, with100100组合问题和combinatorial problems and4,5774{,}577实例。我们比较三种求解器构造范例：本机算法搜索（instances. We compare three solver-construction paradigms: native algorithmic search (蟒蛇Python），通过 Python 求解器 API 进行约束建模（), constraint modeling via a Python solver API (Python + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools）和声明性约束建模（), and declarative constraint modeling (MiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools）。我们研究的对比是表征表面，两个求解器支持的范例具有共享的 CP-SAT 后端。图). The contrast we study is the representational surface, with a shared CP-SAT back-end for the two solver-backed paradigms. Figure1预览这两项发现：previews both findings:Python + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools在每个法学硕士上都获得了最高的正确性，而启发式提示无法可靠地控制基线，并且可以在最弱的法学硕士上急剧回归。 这些实验提供了 LLM 生成时的实例级视图 组合求解器受益于符号委托并且以效率为导向 提示会带来额外的风险。我们的主要贡献是：attains the highest correctness on every LLM, while the heuristic prompt fails to reliably dominate the baseline and can regress sharply on the weakest LLM. These experiments provide an instance-level view of when LLM-generated combinatorial solvers benefit from symbolic delegation and when efficiency-oriented prompting introduces additional risk. Our main contributions are:

  1. 1.

    CP-Sync-XL 基准测试CP-SynC-XL benchmark：我们引入了 CP-SynC-XL，这是一个基准测试，包含 100 个异构约束满足问题和约束优化问题的 4,577 个参数化实例，用于评估 LLM 合成求解器。: we introduce CP-SynC-XL, a benchmark containing 4,577 parameterized instances for 100 heterogeneous Constraint Satisfaction Problems and Constraint Optimization Problems for evaluating LLM-synthesised solvers.

  2. 2.

    代表性分歧Representational divergence：我们表明求解器的正确性主要取决于法学硕士对建模表面的熟悉程度，而不是底层求解器的熟悉程度——: we show that solver correctness depends primarily on the LLM’s familiarity with the modeling surface rather than with the underlying solver—Python + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools尽管与 CP-SAT 共享，但在每个 LLM 上都获得了最高的正确性attains the highest correctness on every LLM despite sharing CP-SAT withMiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools，同时本机, while native蟒蛇Python表现出最高的无声故障率。exhibits the highest rate of silent failures.

  3. 3.

    启发式陷阱Heuristic trap：我们表明，促使法学硕士优化搜索是不可靠的——较小的中值加速掩盖了与六种范式特定的故障模式相关的急剧双峰成本，而迭代细化通常会保留而不是修复这些故障模式；我们的研究结果支持让法学硕士接近正规化，而不是要求它提供搜索优化。: we show that prompting LLMs to optimize search is unreliable—a small median speed-up masks a sharply bimodal cost associated with six paradigm-specific failure modes that iterative refinement often preserves rather than repairs; our findings support keeping the LLM close to formalization rather than asking it to supply search optimizations.

2 相关工作Related Work

法学硕士作为直接组合求解器。LLMs as direct combinatorial solvers.最近的基准测试表明，促使法学硕士解决 NP 难题 随着实例规模的扩大，端到端性能急剧恶化Recent benchmarks show that prompting LLMs to solve NP-hard problems end-to-end deteriorates sharply with instance scale(Fan et al., 2024; Jiang et al., 2026), 并且这种成分限制是结构性的而不是纯粹的 信息性的, and that this compositional limit is structural rather than purely informational(Dziri et al., 2023)。性能也很敏感 问题表征. Performance is also sensitive to problem representation(Duchnowski et al., 2025)：隐含的 约束和自然语言框架在系统上更加困难 比等效的正式编码。这些发现推动了这一转变 从直接的文本推理到符号委托。: implicit constraints and natural-language framings are systematically harder than equivalent formal encodings. These findings motivate the shift from direct textual reasoning to symbolic delegation.

法学硕士作为翻译。LLM-as-translator.第二行将直接推理替换为形式化推理 外部求解器使用的语言。逻辑LMA second line replaces direct reasoning with translation into a formal language consumed by an external solver. Logic-LM(Pan et al., 2023)和卫星导航and SATLM(Ye et al., 2023)将自然语言问题转化为 FOL/SAT 用于现成的证明器，以及 PALtranslate natural-language problems into FOL/SAT for off-the-shelf provers, and PAL(Gao et al., 2023)开创了更广泛的程序辅助学习模型。在 OR 式建模中， NL4选择pioneered the broader Program-Aided LM template. In OR-style modeling, NL4Opt(Ramamonjison et al., 2023)和 奥普蒂穆斯and OptiMUS(AhmadiTeshnizi et al., 2024)目标 MILP，同时target MILP, whileWang and Roth (2025)和andSong and Cohen (2025)目标 CSP/CP 通过 专用数据结构和声明式 MiniZinc 和 PyCSP3 型号target CSP/CP through dedicated data structures and declarative MiniZinc and PyCSP3 models(Nethercote et al., 2007; Lecoutre and Szczepanski, 2020)。这些 研究表明法学硕士通常可以翻译问题描述 成解算器消耗的文物，但他们通常评估一个 一次表面，每个问题一个或几个实例，或问题级别 成功而不是配对的实例级结果分解。作为一个 结果，很难判断报告的成功率是否达到 从底层求解器来看，法学硕士对特定领域的熟练程度 建模表面，或验证者的公差 语义上不正确的解决方案。我们比较三个 相同问题集和 LLM 的表征面，使用 OR-Tools CP-SAT 作为两个求解器支持的公共后端 条件，并分别. These studies establish that LLMs can often translate problem descriptions into solver-consumable artefacts, but they typically evaluate one surface at a time, one or a few instances per problem, or problem-level success rather than a paired instance-level outcome decomposition. As a result, it is difficult to tell whether a reported success rate comes from the underlying solver, the LLM’s fluency with a particular modeling surface, or the verifier’s tolerance for semantically incorrect solutions. We instead compare three representational surfaces for the same problem set and LLMs, use OR-Tools CP-SAT as the common back-end for the two solver-backed conditions, and separate提供provided, 正确correct, 和 实例级别的条件保真度。, and conditional fidelity at the instance level.

法学硕士作为算法/启发式设计师。LLMs as algorithmic / heuristic designers.最近的一条路线使用法学硕士来综合算法本身。 趣搜A more recent line uses LLMs to synthesize the algorithm itself. FunSearch(Romera-Paredes et al., 2024)发展启发式程序 反对适应度函数，尤里卡evolves heuristic programs against a fitness function, Eureka(Ma et al., 2023)发现 奖励函数和启发式进化discovers reward functions, and Evolution-of-Heuristics(Liu et al., 2024b)将 LLM 提案与进化选择相结合；在互动中 设置，couples LLM proposal with evolutionary selection; in interactive settings,Wang et al. (2025)将 LLM 视为 在 MCTS 内查询多项式时间启发式。报道的成功案例 通常依赖于特定于问题的评分预言机， 具有许多 LLM 样本的总体和选择循环，以及自由 将每个启发式专门针对一个问题族。我们采用 综合框架，但研究更接近许多部署的制度 设置：具有有限细化循环的单次生成， 统一的标题treat the LLM as a polynomial-time heuristic queried inside MCTS. The reported successes typically rely on a problem-specific scoring oracle, a population-and-selection loop with many LLM samples, and the freedom to specialize each heuristic to a single problem family. We adopt the synthesis framing but study a regime closer to many deployment settings: single-shot generation with a bounded refinement loop, a uniform rubric across100100问题，并且没有测试时间 进化。problems, and no test-time evolution.

3 方法Method

调查第二节提出的两个问题。To investigate the two questions raised in Sec.1—如何howLLM 应该代表求解者吗？should the LLM represent the solver, and是否whether它应该尝试优化搜索 - 我们使用具有两个轴的受控因子设计：求解器生成it should attempt to optimize search—we use a controlled factorial design with two axes: the solver-generation范例paradigm和and the提示prompt。对于每个自然语言组合问题，LLM 都会生成一个可重用的工件，该工件在运行时消耗实例参数并以基准测试所需的格式返回解决方案。该范式修复了表征表面，跨越本机算法搜索（. For each natural-language combinatorial problem, the LLM produces a reusable artefact that consumes instance parameters at runtime and returns a solution in the benchmark’s required format. The paradigm fixes the representational surface, spanning native algorithmic search (蟒蛇Python），通过 OR-Tools CP-SAT Python API 进行约束建模（), constraint modeling through the OR-Tools CP-SAT Python API (Python + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools），以及 MiniZinc 中的声明式建模（), and declarative modeling in MiniZinc (MiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools）。提示符在). The prompt toggles between a基线baseline只要求正确性和that asks only for correctness and a启发式的heuristic还要求以效率为导向的设计的变体。在每次比较中，我们都固定 LLM、解码参数、实例、评估器、超时和细化预算，因此差异可以归因于范式/提示因素，而不是偶然的实现选择。variant that additionally asks for efficiency-oriented design. Within each comparison, we hold fixed the LLM, decoding parameters, instances, evaluator, timeouts, and refinement budget, so differences can be attributed to the paradigm/prompt factors rather than to incidental implementation choices.

3.1 求解器生成范式Solver-Generation Paradigms

所有范例都在同一评估框架内运行：单个 提示 LLM 的编排循环，执行生成的求解器， 并验证其输出。他们有相同的问题描述， 输入模式和所需的输出键；每个范式的段落 下面描述了法学硕士在每种情况下需要制作什么制品 以及允许使用哪个解算器后端。All paradigms run inside the same evaluation framework: a single orchestration loop that prompts the LLM, executes the generated solver, and validates its output. They share the same problem description, input schema, and required output keys; the per-paradigm paragraphs below describe what artefact the LLM is asked to produce in each case and which solver backend it is allowed to use.

本机算法搜索（Native algorithmic search (蟒蛇Python).这个范式测试了法学硕士作为算法设计师的能力。 LLM 接收问题上下文，并被指示生成一个独立的 Python 算法，仅使用 Python 标准库来解决问题。在运行时，生成的函数采用输入实例并返回所需格式的解决方案。我们禁止使用后端求解工具，迫使法学硕士通过剪枝、动态规划、分支定界或特定问题方法等策略自行设计完整的算法。This paradigm tests the LLM as an algorithm designer. The LLM receives the problem context and is instructed to generate a standalone Python algorithm for solving the problem using only the Python standard library. At runtime, the generated function takes the input instance and returns a solution in the required format. We prohibit the use of backend solving tools, forcing the LLM to design the full algorithm itself through strategies such as pruning, dynamic programming, branch-and-bound, or problem-specific methods.

通过 OR-Tools Python API 进行约束建模（Constraint modeling via the OR-Tools Python API (Python + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools).该范例通过 Python 求解器接口测试法学硕士的约束建模能力。法学硕士收到问题背景并被指示使用 OR-Tools CP-SAT API 表述问题This paradigm tests the LLM’s constraint-modeling capability through a Python solver interface. The LLM receives the problem context and is instructed to formulate the problem using the OR-Tools CP-SAT API(Perron et al., 2023)。 而不是明确指定. Rather than explicitly specifying如何how为了找到解决方案，法学硕士通过决策变量、约束和可选的目标函数对问题要求进行编码，而 OR-Tools CP-SAT 求解器自动执行搜索。to find a solution, the LLM encodes problem requirements through decision variables, constraints, and optionally an objective function, while the OR-Tools CP-SAT solver automatically performs the search.

声明性约束建模（Declarative constraint modeling (MiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools).该范例测试了法学硕士作为声明性建模者的能力。 LLM 接收问题上下文并按照指示生成 MiniZinc 模型。 MiniZinc 是一种高级、独立于求解器的声明式建模 约束满足和优化的语言 问题This paradigm tests the LLM as a declarative modeler. The LLM receives the problem context and is instructed to generate a MiniZinc model. MiniZinc is a high-level, solver-independent declarative modeling language for constraint satisfaction and optimization problems(Nethercote et al., 2007)。 我们采用两步生成管道. We adopt the two-step generation pipeline ofSong and Cohen (2025)作为强大的 MiniZinc 基线，其中首先指示 LLM 生成模型，然后使用 Python 格式化程序将求解器的变量分配映射为所需的格式。我们使用与中相同的 CP-SAT 求解器后端as a strong MiniZinc baseline, where the LLM is first instructed to generate the model and then a Python formatter that maps the solver’s variable assignments into the required format. We use the same CP-SAT solver backend as in thePython + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools设置。setting.

对于每个范式，For each paradigm, the基线baseline提示要求输入正确的 求解器。的prompt asks for a correct solver. The启发式的heuristic提示还建议经典 效率技术：更强的变量/值排序、修剪和 问题分解为prompt additionally suggests classical efficiency techniques: stronger variable/value ordering, pruning, and problem decomposition for蟒蛇Python;更严格的界限，冗余 或隐含约束、对称性破缺和显式搜索注释 （例如; tighter bounds, redundant or implied constraints, symmetry breaking, and explicit search annotations (e.g.整数搜索int_search在迷你锌中，in MiniZinc,添加决策策略AddDecisionStrategy在 CP-SAT 中）对于两个求解器支持的 范式。确切的提示文本逐字给出 应用程序。in CP-SAT) for the two solver-backed paradigms. 两个提示选项的协议是相同的：提示决定 法学硕士最初被要求尝试什么，并进行细化迭代 尝试通过相同的大门。缩放检查是工作流程的 主要效率信号：拒绝无法完成任务的人工制品 预算紧张的情况下更困难的例子旨在鼓励更多 高效生成的求解器。 根据经验，细化主要由基本运行性决定 恢复——修复崩溃、格式违规和超时——不是由 已运行的求解器的加速（秒）The protocol is identical for both prompt options: the prompt determines what the LLM is asked to attempt initially, and refinement iterates that attempt through the same gates. The scaling check is the workflow’s principal efficiency signal: rejecting artefacts that cannot finish a harder instance within a tight budget is intended to encourage more efficient generated solvers. Empirically, refinement is dominated by basic runnability recovery—fixing crashes, format violations, and timeouts—not by speedups on solvers that already run (Sec.C）。 因此，管道产生每个（LLM、范例、提示、问题）元组， 一对人工制品——). Comparing the two artefacts isolates the effect of refinement on correctness, runtime, and optimality.

3.3 方法控制Methodological Controls

两种方法控制使比较保持清晰。Two methodological controls keep the comparison clean.

外部时间控制。External time control.所有求解器运行时预算均已施加 外部是由评估框架决定的，而不是由制品本身决定的。 提示明确禁止LLM设置任何内部时间 或生成代码中的步骤限制（例如，分配给All solver runtime budgets are imposed externally by the evaluation framework, not by the artefact itself. The prompt explicitly forbids the LLM from setting any internal time or step limit in the generated code (e.g., assigning toCpSolver().parameters.max_time_in_seconds）和从 注册其目的是提前停止的回调。没有这个 我们观察到法学硕士经常插入自己的禁令 每个实例的时间上限，这会默默地截断 搜索并混淆范式级别的比较。) and from registering callbacks whose purpose is early stopping. Without this prohibition we observed that LLMs frequently insert their own per-instance time caps, which would silently truncate search and confound the paradigm-level comparison.

范式执行。Paradigm enforcement.提示还排除了常见的方式 法学硕士可能会离开其指定的代表 表面。对于The prompt also rules out common ways the LLM might leave its assigned representational surface. Without this clause LLMs wrap their CP-SAT call in a尝试/除外try/except将困难的实例返回给 一个手卷的Python循环，默默地污染that hands hard instances back to a hand-rolled Python loop, silently contaminatingPython + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools与本机范例。with the native paradigm.

This ranking follows from what it means for each paradigm to provide an answer. In蟒蛇Python，返回的解决方案只是一个输出 手写程序。在, a returned solution is simply the output of a hand-written procedure. InPython + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools，它是一个 CP-SAT-对 LLM 编码的模型的可行分配。在, it is a CP-SAT-feasible assignment to the model that the LLM encoded. InMiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools，这是一个 CP-SAT 可行的分配 首先必须明确 MiniZinc 的类型和格式良好的模型 检查。每一步都缩小了可以被隐藏的错误类别 符合模式的返回值。, it is a CP-SAT-feasible assignment to a model that first had to clear MiniZinc’s type and well-formedness checks. Each step narrows the class of errors that can be hidden by a schema-conformant return value.MiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools因此有 回答时具有最高的条件保真度，尽管其较低 总体正确率。因此，未来的一个自然方向是 在声明式建模中训练或调整模型，使其更加流畅 像 MiniZinc 这样的语言，而不是将当前的差距视为一种 声明式求解器构造的内在局限性。therefore has the highest conditional fidelity when it answers, despite its lower overall correct rate. A natural future direction is therefore to train or adapt models with stronger fluency in declarative modeling languages such as MiniZinc, rather than treating the current gap as an intrinsic limitation of declarative solver construction.

6 结论Conclusion

我们沿着两个轴研究了 LLM 求解器综合：表示和 搜索优化。跨越三个前沿法学硕士，We studied LLM solver synthesis along two axes: representation and search optimization. Across three frontier LLMs,GPT-5.3-法典GPT-5.3-Codex, 双子座3.1专业版Gemini 3.1 Pro, 和, andDeepSeek-V3.2, Python + OR 工具Python + OR-Tools尽管达到了最高的正确性 与共享 CP-SAT 后端attains the highest correctness despite sharing CP-SAT backend withMiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools，同时本机, while native蟒蛇Python最有可能返回模式有效，但是 验证者拒绝的答案。这个模式是符合 建模表面本身就是一个中心瓶颈，不仅是 底层求解器。 在优化轴上，启发式提示的效果适中is the most likely to return schema-valid but verifier-rejected answers. This pattern is consistent with the modeling surface itself being a central bottleneck, not only the underlying solver. On the optimization axis, heuristic prompting yields modestMiniZinc + 手术室工具MiniZinc + OR-Tools加速但具有双峰效应： 一些生成的文物得到改善，而另一些则变得更慢或更少 正确。配对代码审计将这些回归追踪到六个 范式特定的故障模式，当风险集中时 LLM 用未经验证的边界取代了求解器本机机制，硬 修复或算法替换。实际意义是 主要在形式化接口变量上使用 LLM， 约束、目标和仔细范围的原生求解器 注释 - 并使法学硕士撰写的搜索优化服从 独立验证。speed-ups but has a bimodal effect: some generated artefacts improve, while others become slower or less correct. A paired code audit traces these regressions to six paradigm-specific failure modes, with the risk concentrated when the LLM replaces solver-native machinery with unverified bounds, hard fixes, or algorithmic substitutions. The practical implication is to use the LLM primarily at the formalisation interface—variables, constraints, objectives, and carefully scoped solver-native annotations—and to subject LLM-authored search optimizations to independent validation.

附录AAppendix A局限性Limitations

三个控制限制了我们研究结果的外部有效性。 (i) 我们评估了来自晚期的三名前沿法学硕士Three controls bound the external validity of our findings. (i) We evaluate three frontier LLMs from a late-20252025快照； 未来或更小的模型可能会表现出不同的范式偏好， 绝对保真度数字应该被视为快照而不是 比上限。 (ii) 我们将 OR-Tools 修复为后端 两种求解器支持的范式，因此表征分歧 调查结果应被视为 CP-SAT 支持的证据 API/声明性配对而不是作为所有 MIP 的声明， SAT 或 CP 建模管道。 (iii) 我们的经营地点是 单次合成机制snapshot; future or smaller models may exhibit different paradigm preferences, and absolute fidelity numbers should be read as a snapshot rather than an upper bound. (ii) We fix OR-Tools as the back-end across both solver-backed paradigms, so the representational-divergence finding should be read as evidence for this CP-SAT-backed API/declarative pairing rather than as a claim about all MIP-, SAT-, or CP-modeling pipelines. (iii) We operate in the single-shot synthesis regime with≤4\leq\!4精炼轮次 和一个refinement rounds and a256256每个实例的求解器预算；启发式陷阱主张 因此关注有界细化部署设置而不是 FunSearch 风格使用的种群和选择机制 算法综合循环。我们不研究微调、工具增强 代理，或多实例摊销解决，所有这些都在于 超出了本文的范围。s solver budget per instance; the heuristic-trap claims therefore concern bounded-refinement deployment settings rather than the population-and-selection regimes used by FunSearch-style algorithm-synthesis loops. We do not study finetuning, tool-augmented agents, or multi-instance amortised solving, all of which lie outside the scope of this paper.

Each node is equipped with two Intel Xeon Gold processors from the Xeon Scalable family (16 cores per socket, 2.1–2.3 GHz base / 3.7–3.9 GHz turbo, 22 MiB L3 cache per socket), exposing 64 hardware threads (2×162\!\times\!162路物理核心 同时多线程）分布在两个 NUMA 域上。 每个节点至少配置有physical cores with 2-way simultaneous multithreading) distributed over two NUMA domains. 蟒蛇Python包含 M1–M4 以及第五种机制：LLM 写入约束编码carries M1–M4 plus a fifth mechanism: the LLM writes both the constraint encoding和and搜索程序， 所以错误的质量还包括（i）不健全的修剪规则， (ii) DP/DFS 中的基本情况相差一，(iii) 提前终止 不完整的搜索，以及 (iv) 放弃最佳搜索的决胜局 扩展。 M5有两种形状：the search procedure, so wrong mass also includes (i) unsound pruning rules, (ii) off-by-one base cases in DP / DFS, (iii) premature termination of incomplete searches, and (iv) tie-breakers that drop optimal extensions. The safe version is advisory warm-starting (添加提示AddHint）；危险版本转向 同一候选人陷入硬平等 （); the risky version turns the same candidate into hard equalities (模型.Add(... == k)model.Add(... == k)）。我们将它们分组是因为它们都起源于 来自相同的 LLM 行为——构造一个单独的贪婪或 特定领域的候选者并将其提供给 CP-SAT——但我们分开 它们在解释中的含义：提示会减慢搜索速度，但 不要改变可行集，而硬修复可以删除可行集 如果候选人错了，则进行最佳作业。候选人可以 由命名助手生成（). We group them because both originate from the same LLM behavior—constructing a separate greedy or domain-specific candidate and feeding it to CP-SAT—but we separate their implications in the interpretation: hints can slow search but do not change the feasible set, while hard fixes can remove feasible or optimal assignments if the candidate is wrong. The candidate may be produced by a named helper (德夫·沃恩斯多夫def warnsdorff / 绝对贪婪def greedy / def 构造_*def construct_*）或通过内联 “) or by an inlined “初始_*initial_*”里面的计算” computation inside解决实例solve_instance。每当这样的播种时，我们都会标记该模式 机制出现在启发式预设中，但在 基线。在该行为检测器下，该模式是最 流行的. We flag the mode whenever such a seeding mechanism appears in the heuristic preset and is absent from the baseline.
